title: Part 4 Cornered Kira Shot Down in Desperate Chaos

series.summary: After Matsuda shoots Light to stop his final kill, Kira mocks his father and is riddled with bullets before Mikami's gruesome suicide creates a chaotic distraction, allowing a critically wounded Light to flee into the dusk as the Task Force pursues.

cuts.voiceover_text: A single gunshot shatters Kira's final desperate gambit. The bullet rips through Light's right hand, blasting the pen away. He collapses backward in blinding pain, clutching his bleeding wrist. He is terrified. He looks up in disbelief at the shooter. It is Matsuda, the most loyal detective on the task force. Matsuda holds the smoking revolver with tears streaming down his face. His voice breaks with rage, screaming what Light's own father died protecting.

Light slumps against the concrete wall, clutching his shattered hand. Instead of begging for mercy, his face curls into a dark sneer. He mocks his own deceased father. He claims earnest people who pursue justice are fools who always lose. Then Light tries one last sickening manipulation. He tells Matsuda to wake up and shoot the other investigators instead. That cold betrayal shatters Matsuda's restraint. His sorrow turns into pure fury. He aims his weapon, screaming that Light murdered his own father.

Without hesitation, Matsuda opens fire. He pulls the trigger repeatedly, emptying round after round. Bullets tear through Light's shoulder and legs. Kira thrashes in agony across the red-stained concrete. He is utterly broken. Matsuda advances for a fatal headshot, blinded by vengeance. At the final second, Aizawa and Ide rush in. They tackle Matsuda hard to the floor. They pin his arms, knocking the gun away before he can finish the execution.

As Light crawls pathetically in his own blood, his devoted follower watches in disgust. Mikami realizes his self-proclaimed god is nothing more than a coward. In total despair, Mikami pulls out his pen and plunges it straight into his own chest. Fountains of blood spray across the warehouse walls. The room descends into sudden chaos. Detectives and agents shout in horror, rushing toward Mikami's collapsing body. Every eye in the room is diverted. Dragging his bleeding torso across the concrete, Light sees his one chance to escape.

In the chaos, Light slips through the exit doors into the freezing dusk. Detective Aizawa rushes to pursue him, but Near calmly urges him to stop. Near insists Light has no notebook scraps left, and with multiple bullet wounds, he cannot survive. Aizawa refuses to obey and sprints into the cold. Outside, Light staggers blindly down the desolate road, trailing blood in the twilight. With his body failing, will Kira survive the night?
